answer: To deter Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to non-refundable burning that scales superlinearly: attacking with n forged identities imposes an aggregate burned cost scaling as O(n^2). Just as porous karst rock channels water through rigid sinks, burned deposits vanish permanently. Unverified agents cannot wander freely across consensus layers without burning fresh timber reserves of collateral, making mass identity replication economically catastrophic.
